title: Arusha National Park: A Safari Before or After Your Flight
excerpt: Arusha National Park is close to the city and the airport. Ideal for a safari on your first or last day, with canoeing and walking options.
body:
Arusha National Park is often skipped, but it is a great park for the start or end of your trip, less than an hour from Arusha.

## Landscapes

Forest on the slopes of Mount Meru, the Ngurdoto Crater, the Momella Lakes and open grassland. On clear days Kilimanjaro is visible.

## Wildlife

Giraffes, buffaloes, zebras, warthogs, black-and-white colobus monkeys, blue monkeys and many birds. Flamingos often feed in the Momella Lakes. There are no lions in the park, which makes walking safaris possible.

## Activities

- Game drives.
- Walking safaris with an armed ranger.
- [Canoeing on Small Momella Lake](/blog/canoe-safari-arusha/).
- The start of the [Mount Meru climb](/blog/mount-meru-climb-guide/).

## When

A half or full day works on your arrival or departure day.

## Who it suits

- Travellers with a late flight.
- Climbers who want an acclimatisation walk.
- Anyone interested in primates and birds.

Read our [Arusha National Park page](/national-parks/arusha-national-park/) or [plan your trip](/travel-proposal/).
